_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-04 14:25Z full cycle: 4 fresh candidates checked (UCL playoff round, kickoffs 17:30-18:00Z, ~3h out). Union Saint-Gilloise/Bodo-Glimt: clean single-book 3-way (Betway 2.15/3.75/3.00) power-devigs to 0.4433/0.2455/0.3112 vs PM mids 0.435/0.265/0.305 -- within ~1-2pt, efficiently priced, no edge. Hapoel Be'er Sheva/Crvena Zvezda: only a cross-book aggregated range (1.87-1.96 / 3.40-3.86 / 3.50-4.00) -- same mixed-source red flag as prior UCL findings, skipped per coverage precondition. Brewers/Pirates run line (Spread -1.5 market, tonight 23:40Z): found moneyline (-147/+125) and the bare run-line number (-1.5) but no run-line juice/odds at any source -- PM's instrument is the spread, not the moneyline, so this is the established MLB half-point/no-matching-instrument skip, not a numeric edge call; sportsgrid and bettorsinsider game pages 403'd on verification. Istanbul 2 Gijs Brouwer/Manoj Dhamne Manas and Plovdiv 2 Daniel Galan/Georgi Georgiev (Challenger tennis, Aug 10-11 end_date): both descriptions say 'originally scheduled for' a date already past (Aug 3 and Aug 4 08:00 ET respectively) -- the known end_date-is-not-real-match-time trap; could not confirm current match status via search (results returned unrelated matches for the same player), so per the pre-research event-time check both are unverifiable and skipped rather than treated as a discount. No qualifying edge found this cycle. Next event boundary: USG/Bodo-Glimt and the other UCL kickoffs at 17:30-18:00Z (already researched to conclusion, will be in-play after); set to 17:30Z (~3h out, at the pacing cap) so tonight's MLB slate has time to get run-line juice posted; settle+monitor still run every tick.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
